notes: The face pass has become detail passes, and a foot LoRA finally has a job it is good at. A concept LoRA on the whole picture competes with the likeness LoRA and melts what it touches; the same LoRA on a cropped, blown-up patch of just the part it was trained on does exactly what it promises. Each LoRA row now has a DETAIL PASS field: put a body part there, followed by the words that call for it (feet, foot, toes, soles), and that LoRA is kept out of the main paint entirely and applied afterwards to its own patch whenever the picture's description says one of those words. The vision model is asked for the face and every wanted part in one question, the face is repainted first with the identity LoRA as before, then each part with its own LoRA, each pass working on the picture the previous one left, and every box and crop is logged in both coordinate spaces. In the Photo Lab a ticked detail LoRA runs on its patch whether or not the prompt mentions it, and its row says which part it sharpens. The director no longer sees detail LoRAs in its catalogue; they are not its to pick.
